summary: Strengthen technology team leadership, prioritization and reporting in five days. Explore the course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: IT management leadership training helps technology managers, team leads and aspiring CTOs coordinate delivery and clarify decision rights. Using COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 38500, the Kanban Method and DORA metrics, participants map responsibilities, manage work queues and flow, assess capacity, and turn delivery measures into concise stakeholder updates.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for technology professionals who coordinate IT teams, services or delivery work and need practical ways to set priorities, clarify responsibilities and explain progress.
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating or working within a technology team is useful. No coding or platform administration is required; basic spreadsheet use supports the delivery-metrics exercises.
